## Summary
A clear and concise description of what the bug is.

## Steps to Reproduce
1. Go to '...'
2. Click on '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior
What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior
What actually happened.

## Environment
- OS: [e.g. macOS 14, Ubuntu 22.04]
- Browser: [e.g. Chrome 130, Firefox 132]
- Node/Bun version: [e.g. bun 1.3]
- Branch / commit: [e.g. main @ abc123]

## Logs / Screenshots
Paste any relevant console output, error stack traces, or screenshots.

## Severity
- [ ] Blocker (no workaround)
- [ ] Major (workaround exists but painful)
- [ ] Minor (cosmetic or low-impact)
